thesis_breakers_to_check: the company cut its revenue or profit forecast (guidance)
results missed analysts' revenue or EPS estimates
a major customer was lost, or a major customer cut orders
earlier financial statements can no longer be relied on (8-K Item 4.02) or a restatement
the auditor resigned or was dismissed (8-K Item 4.01)
the CEO or CFO left unexpectedly (8-K Item 5.02)
a large share sale that dilutes existing shareholders (S-3, 424B prospectus, 8-K Item 3.02)
a regulator opened an investigation, or major litigation was filed
two or more analyst downgrades within five trading days
several insiders sold on the open market outside pre-planned 10b5-1 trading plans
